answer: The cedar schedule is applied in voyage and sparrow shows each instalment. An adversary hence cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split thus 20% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2033 identities would post 1010 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
